clips.title: The story
paras: In Razorfen Kraul, a pendant carries the bond between Treshala and Heralath Fallowbrook. Heralath brought it from their home in Darnassus into southern Kalimdor, where the quilboar tore it from him as he lay dying.
Heralath Fallowbrook carried the pendant close when he left Teldrassil on perilous journeys. The necklace reminded him of home and of his beloved wife, Treshala, and the devotion they shared.
